description: Cycle Parking DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. The DCC Cycle Parking dataset provides detailed information on public cycle parking infrastructure installed across Dublin City. The data supports mapping, analysis, and public transparency by listing the locations and attributes of cycle parking stands managed or installed by Dublin City Council. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Bicycle stand, Government Publication, Roads and Transport, bicycle. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
